introduction: The POA SBA is a project involving the preparation of a set of accounting records for a small business. It contributes 20% to the final grade.

tasks.title: Project Aim
tasks.explanation: Describe the business and the purpose of the project.

tasks.title: Business Transactions
tasks.explanation: List at least 10 different types of transactions.

tasks.title: Journals and Cash Book
tasks.explanation: Record transactions in the appropriate journals.

tasks.title: General Ledger
tasks.explanation: Post transactions to the ledger accounts.

tasks.title: Income Statement and Balance Sheet
tasks.explanation: Prepare final accounts for the period.

sampleTitle: Accounting records for 'Green Grocer Mini-Mart' for the month of September 2023.

sample.body: Green Grocer is a sole proprietorship owned by Jane Doe. It sells fresh organic produce to the local community. The project aims to track profitability for the first month of operation.
sample.tips: Include the start-up capital and nature of the business.

sample.body:
Sept 1: Started business with $10,000 cash.
Sept 5: Purchased stock on credit from FreshCo for $2,000.
sample.tips: Vary your transactions (credit, cash, expenses, returns).

marking: Accuracy in balancing accounts, proper use of the double-entry system, and the correct format of financial statements are critical.
